expression: sum by (cluster, namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{job="kube-state-metrics"}) / sum by (cluster, namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_spec_replicas{job="kube-state-metrics"}) < 0.5 or sum by (cluster, namespace, daemonset) (kube_daemonset_status_number_ready{job="kube-state-metrics"}) / sum by (cluster, namespace, daemonset) (kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{job="kube-state-metrics"}) < 0.5

annotations.description: Only {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of the pods of {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.deployment }}{{ $labels.daemonset }} in {{ $labels.cluster }} are ready. annotations.description: {{ $value }} pods of {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.controller }} in {{ $labels.cluster }} are in Failed state (evicted pods excluded). For more information on this alert, please refer to this [link](https://aka.ms/aks-alerts/pod-level-recommended-alerts).

expression: sum by (namespace, controller, cluster) (max by(namespace, pod, cluster) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics", phase=~"Pending|Unknown"}  ) * on(namespace, pod, cluster) group_left(controller)label_replace(kube_pod_owner,"controller","$1","owner_name","(.*)")) > 0
